3. Drive the
after:
1. Initiate a CarPlay session between the phone and the HU
2. Open the CarPlay Tests App > Utilities > Protocol Validation > Location Recorder and tap "Start"
3. Drive the vehicle (or simulate motion via CAN tool) so the speed sensor reports a non-zero value
4. Tap End Recording after at least 30 samples are captured, tap the clock icon on the Location Recorder main screen, select the session, and share the results in CSV format
5. Read the SensorAidingSpeed column from the CSV and the vehicle speed signal from the CAN log over the same window
6. Check that SensorAidingSpeed (derived from PASCD) matches the vehicle CAN speed within tolerance, confirming vehicle-sensor-sourced speed
